name: project-name
description: Sample project with feathers and react

scripts.lint:api: docker-compose -f docker-compose.dev.yml run api npm run lint
scripts.lint:app: docker-compose -f docker-compose.dev.yml run app npm run lint
scripts.lint: npm run lint:api ; npm run lint:app
scripts.db:reset: docker-compose -f docker-compose.dev.yml run --rm api npx ts-node scripts db/reset
scripts.db:test-data: docker-compose -f docker-compose.dev.yml run --rm api npx ts-node scripts db/reset db/test-data
scripts.psql: docker-compose -f docker-compose.dev.yml exec postgres psql -U project-name project-name
scripts.pluck:api: docker cp api:/home/node/package.json api && docker cp api:/home/node/yarn.lock api
scripts.pluck:app: docker cp app:/home/node/package.json app && docker cp app:/home/node/yarn.lock app
scripts.migrate: docker-compose -f docker-compose.dev.yml run --rm api npm run db:migrate
scripts.migrate:status: docker-compose -f docker-compose.dev.yml run --rm api npm run db:migrate:status
scripts.migrate:undo: docker-compose -f docker-compose.dev.yml run --rm api npm run db:migrate:undo
scripts.migrate:create: docker-compose -f docker-compose.dev.yml run --rm api npm run db:migrate:create --
scripts.test:run: docker-compose -f docker-compose.test.yml run --rm api-test npm run mocha
